role: I preserve v1 as timestamped evidence collection. This separate draft cannot change a missed v1 origin or its terminal rule.
activation: I need a final model set, committed implementation, offline tests, runner API validation and a public plan witness before 2026-11-01T00:10:00Z. Otherwise I choose a later first origin in a new declaration before freezing any v2 forecast.

missing_days.meaning: These are operational reporting thresholds, not a power guarantee or an inference repair. I report every omission and its timing; volatility-dependent missingness can bias a complete-case analysis.

analysis: I fix a terminal date in the activated declaration. I retain individual scores and coverage throughout, without an outcome-driven extension or a formal significance test.
power_requirement_for_a_later_confirmato: I need a calibrated inference method and a precision or power target justified across declared persistence and effect scenarios. A five-year heuristic or an ESS threshold alone is insufficient.
pre_outcome_limit: Changes before the first mature v1 target are easier to document, but partial target paths are already observable. A new prospective specification must be fixed before its own first forecast.
